versos.grego: Πᾶς γὰρ ἀρχιερεὺς ἐξ ἀνθρώπων λαμβανόμενος ὑπὲρ ἀνθρώπων καθίσταται τὰ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν, ἵνα προσφέρῃ δῶρά τε καὶ θυσίας ὑπὲρ ἁμαρτιῶν,

controles.web: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.
controles.kjv: For every high priest taken from among men is ordained for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins:
controles.livre: Pois todo sumo sacerdote tomado dentre os homens é constituído em prol das pessoas nas coisas relativas a Deus, para apresentar tanto ofertas como sacrifícios pelos pecados;

versos.grego: μετριοπαθεῖν δυνάμενος τοῖς ἀγνοοῦσιν καὶ πλανωμένοις, ἐπεὶ καὶ αὐτὸς περίκειται ἀσθένειαν,

controles.web: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.
controles.kjv: Who can have compassion on the ignorant, and on them that are out of the way; for that he himself also is compassed with infirmity.
controles.livre: e ele é capaz de se compadecer dos ignorantes e dos errados, pois ele mesmo também está rodeado de fraqueza.

versos.grego: καὶ δι’ αὐτὴν ὀφείλει, καθὼς περὶ τοῦ λαοῦ, οὕτως καὶ περὶ ἑαυτοῦ προσφέρειν περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν.

controles.web: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.
controles.kjv: And by reason hereof he ought, as for the people, so also for himself, to offer for sins.
controles.livre: E, por causa desta fraqueza ,ele tem o dever de apresentar oferenda, tanto pelos pecados do povo, como também de si mesmo.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐχ ἑαυτῷ τις λαμβάνει τὴν τιμήν, ἀλλὰ καλούμενος ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ, καθώσπερ καὶ Ἀαρών.

controles.web: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.
controles.kjv: And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was Aaron.
controles.livre: E ninguém toma para si esta honra, a não ser aquele que é chamado por Deus, como Arão.

versos.grego: Οὕτως καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἑαυτὸν ἐδόξασεν γενηθῆναι ἀρχιερέα, ἀλλ’ ὁ λαλήσας πρὸς αὐτόν Υἱός μου εἶ σύ, ἐγὼ σήμερον γεγέννηκά σε·

controles.web: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him,  “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”
controles.kjv: So also Christ glorified not himself to be made an high priest; but he that said unto him, Thou art my Son, to day have I begotten thee.
controles.livre: Assim também Cristo não glorificou a si mesmo para se fazer Sumo Sacerdote; mas sim, àquele que lhe disse: Tu és meu Filho, eu hoje te gerei.

versos.grego: καθὼς καὶ ἐν ἑτέρῳ λέγει Σὺ ἱερεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.

controles.web: As he says also in another place,  “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”
controles.kjv: As he saith also in another place, Thou art a priest for ever after the order of Melchisedec.
controles.livre: Como também diz em outro texto : Tu és Sacerdote para sempre, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.

versos.grego: ὃς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ δεήσεις τε καὶ ἱκετηρίας πρὸς τὸν δυνάμενον σῴζειν αὐτὸν ἐκ θανάτου μετὰ κραυγῆς ἰσχυρᾶς καὶ δακρύων προσενέγκας καὶ εἰσακουσθεὶς ἀπὸ τῆς εὐλαβείας,

controles.web: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,
controles.kjv: Who in the days of his flesh, when he had offered up prayers and supplications with strong crying and tears unto him that was able to save him from death, and was heard in that he feared;
controles.livre: Ele, nos dias de seu corpo carnal, ofereceu com grande clamor e lágrimas, tanto orações como súplicas para aquele que podia o livrar da morte, e foi ouvido por causa da devoção.

versos.grego: καίπερ ὢν Υἱός, ἔμαθεν ἀφ’ ὧν ἔπαθεν τὴν ὑπακοήν,

controles.web: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.
controles.kjv: Though he were a Son, yet learned he obedience by the things which he suffered;
controles.livre: Ainda que fosse o Filho, ele aprendeu a obediência por meio das coisas que sofreu.

versos.grego: καὶ τελειωθεὶς ἐγένετο πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπακούουσιν αὐτῷ αἴτιος σωτηρίας αἰωνίου,

controles.web: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,
controles.kjv: And being made perfect, he became the author of eternal salvation unto all them that obey him;
controles.livre: E, depois de ter sido consumado, ele foi feito autor da eterna salvação a todos os que lhe obedecem;

versos.grego: προσαγορευθεὶς ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀρχιερεὺς κατὰ τὴν τάξιν Μελχισέδεκ.

controles.web: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.
controles.kjv: Called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
controles.livre: e nomeado por Deus como Sumo Sacerdote, segundo a ordem de Melquisedeque.

versos.grego: Περὶ οὗ πολὺς ἡμῖν ὁ λόγος καὶ δυσερμήνευτος λέγειν, ἐπεὶ νωθροὶ γεγόνατε ταῖς ἀκοαῖς.

controles.web: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.
controles.kjv: Of whom we have many things to say, and hard to be uttered, seeing ye are dull of hearing.
controles.livre: Nosso comentário a respeito disso é extenso e difícil de explicar, porque vos tornastes negligentes para ouvir.

versos.grego: καὶ γὰρ ὀφείλοντες εἶναι διδάσκαλοι διὰ τὸν χρόνον, πάλιν χρείαν ἔχετε τοῦ διδάσκειν ὑμᾶς τινα τὰ στοιχεῖα τῆς ἀρχῆς τῶν λογίων τοῦ Θεοῦ, καὶ γεγόνατε χρείαν ἔχοντες γάλακτος, οὐ στερεᾶς τροφῆς.

controles.web: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.
controles.kjv: For when for the time ye ought to be teachers, ye have need that one teach you again which be the first principles of the oracles of God; and are become such as have need of milk, and not of strong meat.
controles.livre: Pois, pelo tempo, vós já devíeis ser mestres; porém novamente tendes necessidade de serdes ensinados os princípios básicos das palavras de Deus; e vos fizestes como se precisásseis de leite, e não de alimento sólido.

versos.grego: πᾶς γὰρ ὁ μετέχων γάλακτος ἄπειρος λόγου δικαιοσύνης, νήπιος γάρ ἐστιν·

controles.web: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.
controles.kjv: For every one that useth milk is unskilful in the word of righteousness: for he is a babe.
controles.livre: Pois qualquer um que depende  de leite é inexperiente na palavra da justiça; porque ainda é um bebê.

versos.grego: τελείων δέ ἐστιν ἡ στερεὰ τροφή, τῶν διὰ τὴν ἕξιν τὰ αἰσθητήρια γεγυμνασμένα ἐχόντων πρὸς διάκρισιν καλοῦ τε καὶ κακοῦ.

controles.web: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.
controles.kjv: But strong meat belongeth to them that are of full age, even those who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern both good and evil.
controles.livre: Mas o alimento sólido é para os maduros, os quais, pelo costume, têm os sentidos treinados para discernirem tanto o bem como o mal.
